title: Pomona: Continuous Code Quality Improvement via Small, Agentic Pull Requests at Bloomberg
abstract: arXiv:2606.06752v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this industrial experience paper, we present Pomona, a lightweight agentic tool that utilises agent skills for continuous code quality improvement. Inspired by the Kaizen (TM) philosophy, Pomona automates a cycle of discovery and incremental repair: a Scanning skill identifies tasks and prioritises them in a backlog, while a Repair skill generates small, easily reviewable pull requests (PRs). This design enables frequent, low-risk improvements while maintaining engineer trust and reducing technical debt. We evaluated Pomona at Bloomberg through a three-month team deployment and a questionnaire distributed to senior engineers. The results are promising: 32/39 PRs (82.1%) were merged with a median time-to-close of just over two hours. Moreover, 10/12 surveyed engineers expressed a desire to adopt Pomona, praising its small diff sizes and focus on code quality. Since our evaluation, another team has adopted Pomona. translated_title: Pomona：通过小型、代理式的拉取请求在彭博实现持续代码质量改进
translated_abstract: 在这篇工业经验论文中，我们介绍了Pomona，一个轻量级的代理工具，利用代理技能实现持续代码质量改进。受Kaizen（改善）理念的启发，Pomona自动化了发现和增量修复的循环：一个扫描技能识别任务并将其优先级排序到待办事项中，而修复技能生成小型、易于审查的拉取请求（PRs）。这种设计实现了频繁、低风险的改进，同时维护工程师信任并减少技术债务。我们在彭博通过三个月的团队部署和面向高级工程师的问卷评估了Pomona。结果令人鼓舞：32/39个PRs（82.1%）被合并，中位关闭时间仅略超过两小时。此外，12名受访工程师中有10人表示希望采用Pomona，称赞其小型差异规模和专注于代码质量。自评估以来，另一个团队已采用Pomona。我们以结论结束。
tldr: Pomona通过自动化扫描与修复循环，生成小型、可审查的拉取请求，在彭博实现82.1%的合并率和高工程师采纳意愿，有效提升代码质量并减少技术债务。
en_tdlr: Pomona automates a scan-and-repair cycle to generate small, reviewable pull requests, achieving an 82.1% merge rate and high engineer adoption at Bloomberg, effectively improving code quality and reducing technical debt.
